task.title: Website — Update a team member on program page — Tara Marlow — Alpha Tulsa
task.description:
REQUEST
Update a team member on program page

NAME
Tara Marlow

EMAIL
tara.marlow@alpha.school

PUBLIC TITLE
Dean of Parents

BIO
Tara has spent 20 years in school operations and enrollment, building systems that keep campuses running and families supported. A Texas transplant, she relocated to Tulsa to help launch Alpha's founding campus and now serves as the first point of contact for every Alpha Tulsa family. Tara has four grown children and spends her time at home 3D printing with her husband and walking their little dog, Opie.

QUOTE
Supporting an Alpha student means supporting the whole family behind them. When parents are informed, connected, and rooting for each other's kids, a campus stops being a building and becomes a community.

HEADSHOT ASSET

DETAIL
just need to be added to the website
